description: Screens one or more party names (people, companies, vessels) against bundled OFAC sanctions lists (SDN + Consolidated) using deterministic exact, alias, and fuzzy matching. Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK with matched records and a signed certificate. Call before onboarding, paying, shipping to, or contracting with any counterparty.
